programme.title: Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show
programme.desc: Welcome to Episode 23 (Season 3) of the Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show presented by Duke Cannon! In this episode, the crew revisits the CJ Kirst vs. Michael Sowers MVP debate. They also make sense of the NCAA eligibility lawsuit that named Joey Spallina, react to Team USA Women dominating the World Championship in Japan, and look ahead to the newly announced Global Lacrosse Games. Ryan Terefenko joins the show to talk about his game-winning goal, and the Denver Outlaws' comeback in Columbus.
